status: FINAL scoped source-conformity correction and explicitly NEW accounting completion; not exact-candidate approval
decision: B — retain the original greater-of rule with total-payment/fee allocation; do not adopt a separate new capped fine.

source.section: 17. Haven resolution; Coin assay and reminting
source.controllingQuote: A knowing holder pays the greater of 10% of the false lot's face value or the assay and remint fees.

classification.correction: Withdraw the incorrect source-attributed 10% cap in FL-25. The cap was an error, not an intended superseding rule.
classification.kept: Loop greater-of payment, actual assay/remint rates, documented innocent-holder protection and real-authority/no-presumed-intent boundaries.
classification.new: Explicitly interpret the greater-of amount as total monetary liability including service fees; define the additional criminal fine as its nonnegative remainder and credit actual prior payments once.

exactReplacementParagraph: KEEP ordinary assay fees at 1% of the face value of the actual accepted assay bill, minimum 1 gp for that real service, and remint fees at 2% of the recovered legitimate metal value accepted for actual reminting. A combined commissioned assay bill receives its minimum once, not per coin, variant or thirty-minute stage; services not incurred create no fee, and an already-owned private testing toolkit creates no fictional desk fee to its owner. KEEP the Loop greater-of rule for a holder lawfully established to be knowing, not a 10% cap. NEW explicit total-payment and fee allocation: let F be the confirmed false lot's face value, A the actual assay fee, R the actual remint fee, and S=A+R for the same assessed lot/bill; the total monetary liability is P=max(0.10×F,S), allocated to service fees S and an additional criminal fine of P−S=max(0,0.10×F−S). Do not charge P plus those fees or levy another 10% fine on top. Compute on exact amounts under FL-21/EC-10's existing final-transaction copper rounding; allocating the total between fees and fine does not itself create extra transactions. Credit actual prior payments and fees already withheld from returned legitimate metal once against the same liability, leaving only its unpaid balance. Confirmed counterfeit coin or plated false currency is seized in full only through actual lawful authority; seizure is neither a fee nor a payment credit. Genuine coins and legitimate metal remain separately identified and are returned with actual fee deductions accounted for once. An innocent holder with documented provenance pays no criminal fine; absent a lawful knowing-holder finding, this rule imposes no criminal fine. Suspicion, ancestry, a failed die or missing documentation alone does not establish knowledge. Assessment, collection and custody require actual authorized actors; an unpaid amount remains an obligation, not automatic borrowing or remote confiscation. Cutting/reminting takes the provider's actual work and links consumed/replaced coin identities to real metal/output quantities without duplication.

affectedRepresentations.section: FL-25 — Coin, crime, labor and rescue preserve real status; third authoring paragraph (fees, knowing-holder liability and custody)
affectedRepresentations.old:
KEEP coins' actual denomination, composition, count/weight, custody and known mint acceptance separately. The Loop assay covers a declared bulk bill: DC10 obvious defect,13 mixed/clipped,16 plated/adulterated,19 expert false mint. Core's specific shaving categories retain their own exact method DCs instead when that is the actual test: trace1–3% shaving/DC12/value95–99% face; light4–8%/DC14/85–95%; heavy9–15%/DC16/70–85%; ruined16–30%/DC10 once weighed/40–70%; washed/plated5–25% recoverable value/DC18 without cutting or magic. Select the method/defect hypothesis before rolling; never require both generic and specific checks to detect the same defect or silently choose the easier after a failure. A known quantity of actual metal and an actual purchaser determine the exact value within a source range; no arbitrary maximum or exact gold recovery follows from passing.

NEW ordinary assay bill limit: up to100 coins or10lb, whichever is reached first, per30 active minutes of actual inspection/sampling; separate materially different variants remain separately identified. Select INT/Investigation or the actual relevant proficient tool once. Keep Core's specific jeweler's-scale/touchstone/milled-edge/merchant-test-kit assistance as access to the proficiency contribution on that appropriate Investigation assay when the actual functioning method applies; it grants no general character proficiency, second PB or supernatural detection. A destructive cut debits the actual coin/sample. Routine already documented weighing is no new roll. Failure leaves uncertainty; only declared false-assessment stakes can supply a fallible report on Critical Failure, never transmute the coin. New genuinely different tests or new evidence permit retry with actual work; speaker rotation does not.

KEEP ordinary assay fee1% face of the actual accepted assay bill, minimum1gp for that real service; remint2% of accepted legitimate metal value. A combined commissioned bill receives its minimum once, not for every coin/variant or thirty-minute stage. An already-owned private testing toolkit does not charge a fictional desk fee to its owner. False/plated portions may be seized only through actual authority; genuine portions and real lawful fees remain identified. Innocent documented possession has no automatic fine. Knowing fraud's fine is capped by the source10% of false face, with actual lawful assessment; do not presume intent from suspicion, ancestry or a failed die. Cutting/reminting takes the provider's actual work and loses/replaces physical coin identities with linked metal/output quantities, not duplication.

KEEP criminal operation stages as separate real uncertainties: obtain an actual buyer/contact; establish trust/terms; move the actual cargo; undertake any particular concealment/laundering act; receive actual payment. NEW skill routing for legacy undefined labels uses existing skills by actual method: Streetwise→CHA/Reputation or Persuasion for networks; Banking→INT/Investigation or applicable actual commercial records/tools; Forgery→actual forgery kit/DEX or INT as the physical task warrants. This creates no new skill, proficiency, forged legal authority or automatic Scribing recipe. Each ordinary contact/terms/collection scene uses SO's declared time; physical movement uses routes, and actual document production uses its reviewed work rather than a generic free roll. Do not run all five stages when one real transaction already resolves them or when the stage is impossible.

KEEP Underways Heat0…6 per actual operation/institution pursuit history: petty illicit1, restricted2, strategic theft/smuggling3, trafficking/forbidden4; for one triggering act choose its highest applicable category once, rather than summing aliases. NEW duplicate guard: event IDs survive repacking/new fronts; split/join preserves actual investigative histories. At each completed24-hour Haven interval involving an active operation, roll once d6≤Heat for a predeclared enforcement complication; coincident faction reporting does not make another Heat roll. Heat0 has none. Actual investigation, seizure/arrest/hearing/standing consequences need their real authority/actors/means, not instant remote confiscation. Bribes10% actual agreed lot value reduce1,25% reduce2, subject to real accepting recipient and effect; active Heat cannot fall below1, no bribe at0, money actually spent once. Declining/unsuccessfully negotiating a bribe does not buy the reduction. Heat cannot be reset by a new operation ID; ending an operation closes that activity but leaves unresolved evidence/legal consequences.

KEEP people as actors, not salvage or fungible goods. Record factual and asserted legal status separately: Free, Contracted, Debt-Bound, Penal, Enslaved, Rescued/Liberated, Disputed; the two rescue terms are preserved source labels for an actual liberation history, not a new automatic immunity. Core's captive½–4Load shorthand is superseded here by reviewed body/casualty handling: actual pounds plus casualty LoadTiny1.5/Small3/Medium6/Large12, equipment once and additional explicitHuge profile where required. Voluntary mobile passengers use TR-12's actual seat/custody record, not 'captive' ownership. Petrified body×10 pounds does not multiply casualty Load; all passenger equipment including melded counts on an external carrier.

KEEP ordinary lawful wages1gp/day unskilled,3gp skilled,10gp specialist with source dangerous-expedition×2, unless the named porter/service or actual contract gives its own rate; don't charge both. NEW wage day buys at most two actual eight-hour work Watches and a protected Rest opportunity, not24 hours of labor. Extra risky/emergency duty needs actual agreement and costs/Rest Debt, not default coercion. Debt-bond records principal, credited wages and agreed simple interest at no more than10% per literalOpening, no hidden compounding or automatic new debt; coercion/kidnapping/fraud/unlawful confinement cannot demand an invented buyout. Preserve source person-market quotations only as reports of abusive/particular institutions, never universal ancestry prices or a purchasable player-agency rule.

KEEP trafficking Evidence Clock0–4: one actual investigation approach adds1 on Success,2 on Critical Success, capped4; repeated same evidence adds0. NEW default investigation work is one active hour per concrete accessible lead with INT/Investigation or actual relevant skill and declared DC/stakes under Core. At4 it supports asking an actually authorized officer for a warrant/hearing or planning a genuine rescue/raid; it does not conjure police, prove a false report, transfer ownership or resolve combat. A captive's actual guards/restraints/escape opportunities are ordinary scene/encounter facts, not powers granted by a legal-status label. Core's six-step rebellion clock, when used for an actual coercive situation, gains one step per distinct learned abuse/opportunity/allied-help/security-failure event and at6 schedules the predeclared real escape/resistance action; no automatic mind control or remote revolt. Keep consent-based adult services distinct from trafficking; table boundaries remain controlling. All literal soul-linked currency, religious/planar and deep-setting references are preserved without interpretation.
